result.justification: The objectives of the study are clearly stated, and the methodology is detailed enough for understanding and reproducibility.

objective_evidence.quote: Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the combined effect of lime and gypsum application on ameliorating soil acidity and grain yield of maize in Hurumu district Southwest Ethiopia.

method_evidence.quote: Treatments were laid out in a randomized complete block design (RCBD) with three replications.
